notes.title: 1.0.4 - Leaderboards
notes.notes:
Leaderboards are now live!
Compete for the top spots on the freestyle and slalom leaderboards.

notes.title: 1.0.3 - Keyboard Control Bug Fix
notes.notes:
In adding controller support, I had accidentally introduced a bug in the keyboard-arrow controls!
This has now been identified and fixed.

notes.title: 1.0.2 - Controller Support
notes.notes:
This update adds controller support to the main game and menus.
There should be smooth functionality with Xbox, Playstation and generic controllers.
Please let me know if you experience any problems!

notes.title: 1.0.1 - Achievements & Boost Recharge
notes.notes:
[i]Yeti Ski [/i]now has ten achievements to earn.
Pull tricks, build slalom streaks and escape yetis to become king of the mountain!
